---------------


Hey everyone -- this is my first mod so let me know if there's anything wrong with it!

A lot of my friends and I agreed that we'd want to romance Sam if his hair weren't so flashy and big. There are a lot of good Sam portrait mods but many change his appearance too much for my liking. This one is compatible with Seasonal Outfits and gives him skater hair + his spring outfit is a yellow flannel!

[b][u]OUTFIT UPDATE![/u][/b]
It came to my attention that Ailin does not have explicit permissions for reuploading and I was having trouble finding contact info -- so I made my own winter outfits. If they see this and want to reach out to me please do! [s]I honestly prefer the original to my edit LOL[/s]

[u][size=3][b]Installing this Mod[/b][/size][/u]

This requires Seasonal Outfits!

Unzip the file and copy the assets folder. Replace the original Sam files in the Seasonal Outfit Folder with the files in this zip.

Btw! If you're looking for the interface I used its the Starry Sky Interface by Walpi (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2668)

[b][u]PORTRAIT COMMISSIONS
[/u][/b]Don't mind me -- but I also do Stardew Valley portrait commissions, you can contact me on Instagram @ atomizerkerosene :) I don't accept donation points for the sake of the original creators but you can support me there!
